vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP; operates SYS-15 SIEM and EDR and monitors SYS-07 OT sensors)
tier_rationale: Security logs from OT and business IT; EDR agents with privileged rights on business endpoints; supports BP-13 and detection for every High process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) plus bridge letter; annual service review with a detection test
subservice_organizations: SIEM SaaS platform carved out (the MSSP relies on the platform provider's SOC 2)
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: high-severity escalation missed the 15-minute target in 2 of 40 samples. Management response: staffing added
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer defines log sources, keeps the escalation contact list, approves containment, and reviews monthly reports. Mapped to AU-2, IR-4, SI-4. Company gaps: OT log sources and retention (POAM-005), sensor coverage (POAM-014)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; MSSP continuity plan tested annually per the report. BP-13 RTO 4 h is met by the MSSP working from its own platform (P05)
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 15 minutes for OT alerts; written incident notice within 24 hours if the MSSP itself is breached
follow_up: Obtain the SIEM platform provider's SOC 2; confirm the MSSP may isolate business endpoints only, never OT devices, in the next contract schedule

vendor_and_service: Identity provider (SYS-09; SSO and MFA for business systems, cloud, and the remote access gateway)
tier_rationale: Controls remote access to OT (CCS-8); supports BP-01 and BP-05
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus status history review
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures MFA, conditional access, administrator roles, and break-glass accounts. Mapped to IA-2(1), AC-2, AC-6. Company gap: phishing-resistant authenticators for gateway users (P01 R-002, R-018)
availability_vs_bia: 99.99% monthly uptime commitment; no RTO stated. Gas control does not depend on it (P05 finding 1); BP-05 RTO 4 h has a phone and email fallback
incident_notification_terms: Security incident notice per the service terms
follow_up: Security keys for all gateway users (FY2027 budget); test break-glass accounts quarterly

vendor_and_service: Public cloud provider (SYS-11 landing zone: 5 accounts including OT analytics and backup)
tier_rationale: Hosts measurement, GIS, the leak-detection model, and immutable backups; Restricted data
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 for the services in use, plus the provider's shared responsibility documentation
subservice_organizations: None material for the services in use
exceptions_noted: None relevant to the services in use
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer owns identity, network rules, encryption keys, logging, and backup configuration (P04). Mapped to AC-2, SC-7, SC-12, AU-2, CP-9. Company gap: OT analytics account not yet in the TSA plan (POAM-018)
availability_vs_bia: Regional services with multi-zone design; the backup account is in a second region. Meets BP-06, BP-07, and BP-11 RTOs of 24 to 48 h
follow_up: Review the next report for the OT analytics services

tier_rationale: Holds Confidential business data and is the main channel for shipper and lateral owner communication outside an incident; supports BP-03 and BP-05
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures sharing, retention, data loss rules, and administrator roles. Mapped to AC-3, MP-3, SI-4. Company gap: SSI marking and data loss rule (POAM-011)
availability_vs_bia: No RTO stated. Both P08 runbooks assume it is unavailable and use out-of-band channels
follow_up: Data loss rule for SSI markings by 2026-11-30

vendor_and_service: SCADA software vendor (SYS-01 and SYS-02 platform support, updates, and remote support through the gateway)
tier_rationale: OT access; holds copies of SCADA configurations (Restricted); supports BP-01 and BP-04
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 if available; otherwise a security questionnaire, an on-site assessment of the support environment, and contract terms, annually
report_type_and_period: No SOC 2 report. Security questionnaire returned 2026-09-08; on-site assessment of the support environment scheduled 2026-12-08
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company controls the gateway, accounts, and update staging; the vendor controls its support environment and code signing. Mapped to SA-9, SR-6, SI-7, MA-4. Risks P01 R-012 and R-048
availability_vs_bia: Support response targets: 1 hour for a control-impacting fault, 24x7. Supports the BP-01 RTO of 1 h
incident_notification_terms: Contract has no breach notice term. Required at renewal: notice within 24 hours (STD-03)
follow_up: Complete the on-site assessment; limit configuration copies held by the vendor; add breach notice and technician list terms at the 2027 renewal (POAM-013)
reviewer_and_date: Security Manager and SCADA and OT Engineering Manager, 2026-09-12 (questionnaire review)

vendor_and_service: Customer activities website vendor (SYS-12; nominations, scheduling, capacity release, Informational Postings)
tier_rationale: Supports BP-05 (High) and FERC postings (BP-08); shipper contract data
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity) plus bridge letter
report_type_and_period: Requested 2026-09-02; vendor states a Type 2 for 12 months ending 2026-06-30 will be issued in 2026 Q4
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer manages shipper accounts and administrator roles. Mapped to AC-2, IA-2, SA-9. Risks P01 R-019, R-020, R-051
availability_vs_bia: Vendor states 4 h recovery for the nomination service. BP-05 needs RTO 4 h and RPO 1 h; confirm in the report
incident_notification_terms: No breach notice term today. Required at renewal: notice within 24 hours (P01 R-020)
follow_up: Review the report on receipt; test manual nominations each year

vendor_and_service: Compressor OEM (unit control panels; remote diagnostics and predictive maintenance service, AI-002)
tier_rationale: OT access to unit control panels; supports BP-02
assurance_required: Security questionnaire, contract security terms, and remote diagnostics only through the DMZ; SOC 2 if available
report_type_and_period: No SOC 2 report. Questionnaire sent 2026-08-20; not yet returned
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company must control every path into OT (STD-04). The OEM cellular modem bypassed this (P07; POAM-003). Mapped to AC-17, MA-4, SC-7, SA-9
availability_vs_bia: OEM field service response 24 h for unit faults. Not a recovery provider for SCADA
incident_notification_terms: No security terms in the current contract (P07 SA-9 sample). Required: notice within 24 hours, named technicians, data path through the DMZ
follow_up: Contract security terms and the DMZ data path by 2026-10-31 (POAM-003); P10 AI-002 conditions
reviewer_and_date: SCADA and OT Engineering Manager and Supply Chain Manager, 2026-08-20 (request)

vendor_and_service: Telecom carrier (SYS-05 MPLS circuits and cellular service at 41 field sites, including the operated laterals)
tier_rationale: Carries SCADA traffic; supports BP-01, BP-02, and BP-04; a subservice organization for the contract operations services
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) if available; otherwise carrier security attestation and service level reports
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company encrypts and authenticates SCADA traffic where devices support it and monitors gateway logins (STD-04). Mapped to SC-8, SC-7, CP-8. Risks P01 R-007, R-014
availability_vs_bia: Carrier restores service per its service levels (4 h on MPLS); cellular sites have no committed restoration time. Satellite backup at 12 critical sites; second carrier at the 15 largest delivery points planned (P01 R-014)
incident_notification_terms: No security terms today (P07 SA-9 sample). Required at renewal: outage and security incident notice
follow_up: Obtain the report or attestation; add security terms at renewal (POAM-013)

vendor_and_service: Leak-detection model vendor (AI-001; runs its model in the company's OT analytics cloud account)
tier_rationale: Access to OT analytics data (historian replica) and the model namespace; model output informs controllers (BP-07; P10)
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) or equivalent, plus model change notice terms
report_type_and_period: Type 2 (Security) for 12 months ending 2026-03-31 received 2026-09-09; review in progress
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company controls the account, data path, and (from 2026-11-30) the staging slot for model updates (P10 condition 2). Mapped to CM-3, SA-9, AC-6. Risk P01 R-027
incident_notification_terms: Required by the P10 contract amendment: 30 days notice of model changes; security incident notice within 24 hours
follow_up: Finish the review by 2026-10-31; contract amendment by 2026-11-30 (POAM-019)
reviewer_and_date: Director of Gas Control and Security Manager, review started 2026-09-14
